name: Himejima Gakuen ~Ingoku no Nikutai Shidou Kyouzai~
original_name: 姫島学園～淫獄の肉体指導教材～
source:
All the news talked about was the Japanese population crisis.
"How to educate students" was one of the hottest discussions, with ongoing coverage of 3 particular teachers.
The teachers were reassigned to Himejima School (Himejima Gakuen, lit. "Princess Island School"), where other faculty spoke of a ghostly rumor. Whether it was true or not remained to be seen.

Each of the teachers came to Himejima School with individual plans...
... The school has plans for them, too.
Let the lessons in pleasure begin... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE161603.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
所有谈论的新闻都是日本人口危机。
“如何教育学生”是最热门的讨论之一，持续报道了三位特定的老师。
老师们被重新分配到姬岛学园（姬岛学园，字面意思是“公主岛学校”），其他教职员工谈到了一个幽灵般的谣言。这是否属实还有待观察。

来到姬岛学校的老师们都带着各自的计划……
…学校也为他们制定了计划。
让快乐的课程开始吧…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE161603.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
